normalization.translation: Typed world point/rectangle fields only; dimensions/directions/travel/relative offsets remain unchanged.
normalization.exact: Actual geometry, complete N×N interface matrix with UNKNOWN retained, permissions, routes, resource/ability requirements, real mechanism parameters and control program. Identity/title/seed/decoration never create families.
limitations: Conservative fingerprints are not complete graph-isomorphism or gameplay equivalence proofs.
Source/controller differences and UNKNOWN permissions are retained; matching incomplete metadata never grants a certificate.
A nominally unvisited platform can support recovery, projectiles, enemies, ports or alternative strategies.
Matching geometry under distinct Foundry profiles is explicitly separated.
Different frozen control programs may be alternative strategies of one geometry; they never establish a new gameplay family by themselves.
